scenicChapters.narrative: For 17 km this is Castle Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Castle Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

bertha-benz-memorial-route.story: A 90 km one-way ride from near Mannheim, about 1 h 29 of riding. On the way it passes Schwetzingen, Wiesloch and Bruchsal. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
